title: Provide coordinated offline upgrade and crash recovery
outcome: Engram-only upgrade under operationally maintained downtime creates verified recovery artifacts, activates a supported imported database, and recovers interrupted transitions without losing originals.
acceptance: Explicit operator confirmation documents continuous downtime as a precondition, not a proven lock; no TermAl integration or new ordinary-open admission mechanism is required.

Fault-injected backup, import, validation and switch retain verified originals and executable identity; recovery checks real files against the journal, refuses contradictory state, and never rolls back after the durable resume decision.

completion.summary: Delivered work reconciled against retained evidence; acceptance unchanged.
